description: This Java source file defines the RetrieveFeaturesStrategy class, which implements a command strategy for handling retrieve features requests for 'Thing' entities. It processes the command, extracts features from the 'Thing', constructs appropriate responses, and manages entity tags.

classes.name: RetrieveFeaturesStrategy
classes.description: A final class implementing a command strategy to handle retrieve features commands for 'Thing' entities, utilizing immutable pattern and extending AbstractThingCommandStrategy.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Handles the retrieve features command by extracting features, converting them to JSON, and creating a response. Returns a result indicating success or failure.

methods.name: extractFeatures
methods.description: Extracts features from a 'Thing' entity, throwing if the entity is null.

methods.name: getFeaturesJson
methods.description: Converts features into a JSON object, considering selected fields and schema version.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Returns the previous entity tag for a given command and entity, used for concurrency control.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Generates a new entity tag from the 'Thing' entity, if features are present.
